      James Comey
      and
      Letitia James
      .

    • Tumultuous Tenure: Despite being an loyalist, her management was criticized for causing high turnover of senior DOJ staff. 
    She was replaced on an acting basis by
    Todd Blanche
    .

    President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi on Thursday due to his frustration with her handling of the Epstein files. He’s expressed frustration over her not investigating and prosecuting enough of his political opponents. CNN reports that Environmental Protection Agency administrator Lee Zeldin is up for consideration as Bondi’s replacement. In a Truth Social Post on Thursday afternoon Trump said, “Pam Bondi is a Great American Patriot and a loyal friend, who faithfully served as my Attorney General over the past year.
